integration_notes: No runtime loader, placement, registry or gameplay writes in this unit.
Named reference nodes identify ranges of merged steel geometry; they do not add a mesh draw.
Every material resource is shared by slot, not by file or state.
Blue seams are unlit inlays, not attack cues.
Landmark and plate placement/collision belong to the integration owner.
ruling: P-R6 overrides the original circular opening and unready/slate poses; landmarks are non-colliding.
